persistenceOverride: Latest user request supersedes memory-only criteria below. Authenticated actor + exact raw text + full YYYY-WW-SS stores successful analyses under private ignored data/runtime/paste-analysis. No disk TTL; 15min memory refresh reads disk without Claude. Source/week change is separate; explicit force replaces atomically only after success. Per-actor isolation, no client-supplied results, lock fails closed across processes, pending calls deduplicated. Automatic budget counts new analyses only; cached lookups remain available beyond limit. Existing mappings/live ERP values reload on explicit opening. Deploy in-place reset preserves untracked runtime directory. No shared ERP writes.
savedReadPriority: On mount, read-only lookupOnly hydration restores exact actor/text/fullweek saved results independently of viewport, automatic toggle and saving state; a miss returns null without consuming model budget or joining model queue. Saved analyses remain directly openable. Only viewport-near (IntersectionObserver root null) eligible misses auto-analyze sequentially. Restoring, queued and analyzing states are distinct; failed explicit reanalysis retains prior successful result. No ERP writes or automatic application.
automaticFailureBudget: Reserve new automatic attempts before network invocation, including failed attempts. Refund only a confirmed saved cache hit. Read-only lookup and explicit user analysis remain available beyond automatic budget.

criteria.cache: page-local only, 15 minute TTL, max100 completed entries, duplicate in-flight calls shared and clones returned
criteria.automatic: one sequential call, max20 automatic calls per page lifetime; near-viewport actionable rows only while visible/online and not saving
criteria.manual: Exact source/week saved successful analyses remain usable without display TTL; temporary analyses keep15min TTL. All direct first analyses use authenticated persistent prepare. Current ERP/mapping reads still occur on opening.
criteria.application: matched is advisory, not committed; application audit remains separate
criteria.sideEffects: existing authenticated parse-paste API only: ERP SELECT and LLM usage accounting; no write/lease/confirmation APIs from automatic preparation

workspacePersistence: Same browser actor from authenticated auth/me + canonical YYYY-WW-SS draft: raw/exclusions/manual matching/evidence/base-remain inputs/verified historic completion retained without TTL. Never persist leases,tokens,presence,live order/stock baselines or saving. Completion locks require exact input/intent fingerprint, successful verified rows and same actor/fullweek. Reopening the identical completed input does not release the delta-write lock. Changing scope never inherits completion. Restored current ERP values are GET again; no replay.
